issues: Upper-left pressing finger and middle-right pinch are realistic flesh-like hands with detailed nails/skin, weakening the all-clay material logic.
uncertainties: A single still image conveys the resting return through the rounded lower end and adjacent 다시 놓기 wording; actual elastic motion is not measured.

observations.type: Native: rounded violet title syllables have thick, separated strokes; SOFT GRAVITY and descriptor remain readable despite all-violet weight. 720: full venue fits without horizontal crushing. 320: title/action survive; venue becomes small.
observations.space: Continuous clay occupies left/top through center to lower resting mass. Three action fragments align beside those states. Upper title fits close to the right boundary; no clipping, but right margin is tight.
observations.material: Native: violet clay has directional pull striations, plump contact masses and lower-right shadows. Hands instead contain detailed skin and nail modeling, creating the concrete mixed-material defect to repair.
observations.ai_slop: No decorative numbers, fake labels or unrelated props. Title/action/sculpture directly relate to this exhibition. Dense skin texture on the two hands overrides the planned clay-medium rule, so it is not passed as flawless.

repair_decision.target: Only the two realistic hands: turn them into coherent ivory clay sculptural hand fragments without photorealistic skin pores or nails; preserve copy, violet flow, layout, depth and yellow/violet palette.

residuals: Close right margin around the upper raised title, with no current cropping.
Lower resting end remains attached to the elongated flow; recovery is represented as a connected form rather than actual animation.
